scan.summary: This is a Tier II indoor marijuana producer license issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission authorizing Evergreen Botanicals to cultivate up to 10,000 square feet of mature plant canopy at the Bailey Hill location in Eugene. The license is renewable annually and currently expires on March 2, 2027. The license contains five conditions governing tracking, surveillance, employee permits, ownership changes, and premise requirements.
scan.freshness_note: This license was reissued on March 3, 2026 for a one-year term ending March 2, 2027. As of today (September 29, 2026), it is approximately 6 months from expiration and renewal should be initiated by February 10, 2027 (20 days before expiry). Request an updated version if renewal has not been submitted.

expected_missing.title: Electrical and water usage report or submission compliance
expected_missing.why: ORS 475C.065 requires marijuana producers to submit electrical or water usage reports at the time of applying for or renewing a license. This license does not display evidence that such a report was submitted with the renewal.
expected_missing.basis: Oregon statute ORS 475C.065(4)(f) requires producers to 'submit, at the time of applying for or renewing a license under ORS 475C.033, a report describing the applicant's or licensee's electrical or water usage.' This document does not reference such a submission.

expected_missing.title: Evidence of marijuana worker permits for all staff
expected_missing.why: Condition 3 requires all employees who handle marijuana items to hold current marijuana worker permits. The license does not show evidence of such permits being held by staff.
expected_missing.basis: While the condition is stated in the license, documentation of actual worker permits for Evergreen's employees would be held separately by the company and is expected to be kept on file

expected_missing.title: General Liability Insurance documentation
expected_missing.why: ORS 475C may require producers to carry general liability insurance. The license does not display proof of insurance.
expected_missing.basis: Cannabis producers in Oregon may have insurance requirements under ORS 475C.165 and related rules, though this is inferred from statute rather than checked against specific OLCC administrative rules

scan.confidence_notes: High confidence in the identity, dates, conditions, and factual contents of this license—these are all explicitly stated in the OLCC-issued document. The license is current as of today. Renewal deadline (February 10, 2027) is clearly calculated from the stated expiration date and 20-day requirement. Video surveillance and CTS tracking requirements are standard conditions confirmed through web search. Marijuana worker permits are confirmed as mandatory under ORS 475C and OLCC rules. The status is 'current' with no gaps in the document itself, as permits are the agency's documents and have no compliance gaps—instead, the company's duty is to meet the stated conditions and renew on time. The statutory authority and rule references (ORS 475C, OAR 845-025) are confirmed. The electrical/water usage reporting requirement and general liability insurance requirement are inferred from statute but are expected missing documents rather than gaps in this permit itself.

OREGON LIQUOR AND CANNABIS COMMISSION
9079 SE McLoughlin Blvd, Portland, Oregon 97222
RECREATIONAL MARIJUANA PRODUCER LICENSE
License number: 020-1004763A8B2
Licensee: Evergreen Botanicals, LLC
Trade name: Evergreen Botanicals
Licensed premises: 2210 Bailey Hill Road, Eugene, Oregon 97405
License type: Producer — Tier II, Indoor
Canopy limit: 10,000 square feet mature plant canopy
Original issue date: March 3, 2022
Current term: March 3, 2026 to March 2, 2027
Expiration date: March 2, 2027
This license is issued under ORS 475C and the rules of the Commission in OAR chapter 845, division 25, and
authorizes the licensee to produce marijuana at the licensed premises named above, subject to those rules and to the
conditions below.
Conditions of this license:
1. The license is valid only for the premises named above and is not transferable to any other location or person.
2. The license must be renewed annually. A renewal application and the renewal fee must be received by the
Commission no later than 20 days before the expiration date. A licensee that has submitted a complete renewal
application before that date may continue to operate until the Commission acts on it.
3. All marijuana items at the premises must be tracked in the Cannabis Tracking System, and every employee who
handles marijuana items must hold a current marijuana worker permit issued by the Commission.
4. Video surveillance meeting OAR 845-025-1450 must be maintained at the premises and recordings kept for at
least 90 days.
5. Any change in ownership, in the premises, or in the persons with a financial interest in the licensee must be
reported to the Commission before it takes effect.
This license must be displayed at the licensed premises where it can be seen by the public.
Issued by the Oregon Liquor and Cannabis Commission
Date of issue for the current term: March 3, 2026
Authorized signature: ____________________ Licensing Director
